critical_code_review_comments: services/loop_beta.py::log_gate_decision — swallows all exceptions via try/except with a debug log. Correct choice for best-effort telemetry (must not break the primary request path), verified in practice.
services/loop_beta.py::gate_parity_check — mismatch threshold of >=0.30 abs delta AND both sides >=5 requests is a reasonable heuristic; matches the 212m-181 drift signature.

services/mode_d_debugger.py — the new `if error_ctx['file_refs'] and not github_pat:` branch (line ~703) is correctly ordered BEFORE the existing 'file_contents empty' branch (line ~739). Both branches now have identical shape (clarify=True, can_auto_fix=False, cause description). Verified via unit tests with mocked db + monkeypatched llm_diagnosis that llm_diagnosis is NOT called in the no-pat branch (previous bug).

extract_error_context_from_text() has a pre-existing regex-capture-group quirk: `re.findall(r'[\w/.-]+\.(jsx?|tsx?|py|ts)[:(]\s*\d+', msg)` returns only the extension string (e.g. 'py'), not the filename. file_refs therefore stores extensions rather than actual paths. Not caused by this iteration but worth noting: any downstream code that treats file_refs entries as filenames (e.g. the read_file loop at line ~677) will attempt to read a file literally named 'py' or 'jsx'. Pre-existing bug, out of scope for this review, but flagging.
